variant.description: Controls the visual style and layout of the navigation menu. - full: Standard menu with icons and labels (default). - icon-only: Compact, icon-only menu (use only when no flyouts/groups are present). -...

flyoutVariant.description: Visual variant of the flyout. One of Full (default) or Compact. Available when variant==Full.

smallScreen.description: When true, adapts the layout for small screens (e.g., moves logo into the footer area and adjusts item layout).

items.description: The items and groups of the `main` slot (a group holds more, to any depth), as a list with one object for each: `tag` and then the element's attributes by name, `text`, `id` (reported by the element's events), `slot` and `children` (objects of the same form). Tags and attributes: `obc-navigation-item` (label, href, checked, variant, group, groupSelected, hasIcon, hasTrailingIcon, treeMode, treeBranches, terminalType, alerts); `obc-navigation-item-group` (label, href, checked, variant, hug, hasIcon, treeMode, treeBranches, terminalType, alerts, defaultOpen).

footerItems.description: The items and groups of the `footer` slot (settings, help), as a list with one object for each: `tag` and then the element's attributes by name, `text`, `id` (reported by the element's events), `slot` and `children` (objects of the same form). Tags and attributes: `obc-navigation-item` (label, href, checked, variant, group, groupSelected, hasIcon, hasTrailingIcon, treeMode, treeBranches, terminalType, alerts); `obc-navigation-item-group` (label, href, checked, variant, hug, hasIcon, treeMode, treeBranches, terminalType, alerts, defaultOpen).

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
